title: SR 159 over Branch Spencer Creek
source_note: 2020 Stage 1 public version · Primarily general arrangement drawings
assumptions: This is a 3-sided precast structure rather than a conventional girder bridge. Manufacturer fabrication details and final design documents are needed.
Internal reinforcing bars, tendons and embedded hardware are excluded. Fabrication details absent from the drawings are not claimed as reconstructed.
Colors distinguish components. Individual volumes may overlap at assembly boundaries and must not be summed as a quantity takeoff.
The vertical datum is the frame leg base at EL 491.54 ft. Roof soffit EL 501.54 ft and a rise of 10 ft are applied.
The alternative 32 ft span is not used; the main drawing's 30 ft span is modeled. No segment count was invented where the drawings did not provide one.
Post sections and spacing, roof thickness, footing sizes, fill and pavement surfaces are approximate. Differences between wingwall H1/H2 tables and plan elevations require source clarification.

detail_coverage.detail: Opening 30 ft by height 10 ft by waterway length 32 ft, with 15 in sidewalls. Roof thickness is approximated as 15 in; no bottom slab is modeled.
Includes 32 ft 6 in headwalls, 21 ft 6 in wingwalls (4 total) and H1/H2 table values. Source conflicts in upper corner elevations are documented as approximations.
Pavement over fill with headwall-side W-beam guardrails and posts. Attachment hardware, bolts and roadway transitions are simplified.

Fabrication segment joints, manufacturer haunches, reinforcement, streambed, bank protection and site fill limits are not modeled. Available general drawings cannot establish detailed fabrication geometry.

coordinate_system.native: X longitudinal / Y transverse / Z up; metres. Local datum described in assumptions.

model_scope: Exterior drawing reconstruction; source-derived and inferred geometry tagged separately.
